item.title: Django Class-Based Views
item.description: Django has two kinds of views: function-based views and class-based views. The role of a view is mainly to fill in logic and return a response body. Function-based views are hard to extend and have a low rate of code reuse. Class-based views, on the other hand, can use inheritance
